description: List paginated enrollments that took a specific branch path (or reached a step) in a sequence, with redacted evaluation reasons (never raw subscriber values) and optional post-step conversion status for a goal or event. Use pathId from get_sequence_path_stats or get_sequence_stats branches[].paths[].pathId (or 'continued'/'exited' for condition steps), or bucket ('unmapped' or 'unrecorded') for synthetic decision buckets.

bucket.description: Optional synthetic bucket filter for branch or condition nodes: 'unmapped' (earlier versions) or 'unrecorded' (legacy rows). Mutually exclusive with pathId.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

conversionWindowDays.description: Conversion window in days (1 to 90, default 7).

end.description: ISO 8601 end of arrival window; send start too.

eventName.description: Optional event name to annotate each row with conversion status. Mutually exclusive with goalId.

goalId.description: Optional goal ID (or 'default-revenue') to annotate each row with conversion status and trackedValue. Mutually exclusive with eventName.

nodeId.description: Node ID of the branch, condition, or step.

pathId.description: Optional configured path ID for branch or condition nodes (from branches[].paths[].pathId). Mutually exclusive with bucket.

period.description: Rolling window ending now for arrival time: 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, or 90d.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID from list_sequences or get_sequence.

start.description: ISO 8601 start of arrival window; send end too.

name: list_sequence_path_subscribers

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_sequence_path_subscribers` MCP tool.

bucket.description: Filtered synthetic bucket ('unmapped' or 'unrecorded'), or null.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

nodeId.description: Node ID of the branch, condition, or step.

outcome.description: Optional outcome used to compute each row's conversion flag and trackedValue, or null.

pathId.description: Filtered configured path ID, or null when listing all enrollments or a synthetic bucket.

subscribers.description: Paginated enrollment rows: subscriberId, email, name, tokenId, decidedAt, pathId, redacted reason, converted, convertedAt, trackedValue.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

timedOut.description: True when the ClickHouse lookup timed out.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
